conclusion.label: endorses

report:
**Conclusion:** The claim is **true**. The Kyleena (levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system) 19.5 mg IUD is FDA-approved for the prevention of pregnancy for up to five years. The FDA first approved Kyleena on September 16, 2016, and its official prescribing information states it is "a hormone-releasing IUD that prevents pregnancy for up to 5 years." Multiple sources, including Bayer's announcement, FDA labeling, and clinical references, consistently confirm this five-year duration of use.

**Sources:**
- https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/fda-approves-bayers-kyleena-levonorgestrel-releasing-intrauterine-system-195-mg-for-prevention-of-pregnancy-for-up-to-five-years-300330006.html
- https://www.healio.com/news/primary-care/20160920/fda-approves-bayer-iud-kyleena
- https://www.kyleena-us.com/prescribing-information
